content: Thực hiện phân tích toàn diện toàn bộ mã nguồn của dự án dùng tập trung sơ đồ đề giải thích, tập trung chủ yếu vào phần backend với các nội dung chi tiết sau: (1) Kiến trúc hệ thống backend – mô tả rõ ràng cấu trúc tổng thể, các lớp (layer) như controller, service, repository, model, middleware, authentication/authorization, cơ chế dependency injection (nếu có) và luồng xử lý request/response; (2) Công nghệ & framework – liệt kê ngôn ngữ, framework (Spring Boot, Express, Django, v.v.), cơ sở dữ liệu, ORM/ODM, message queue, cache, cấu hình môi trường (dev/staging/prod) và các thư viện bên thứ ba quan trọng; (3) Luồng nghiệp vụ chính – trình bày step-by-step từ khi API nhận request đến khi trả về response, gồm validation, xử lý logic, tương tác DB, transaction, xử lý lỗi và trả kết quả; (4) Bảo mật & hiệu năng – phân tích cách mã hóa, xác thực (JWT, OAuth2), phân quyền (RBAC/ABAC), rate-limiting, logging, monitoring, caching, database indexing và tối ưu query;  Đối với frontend: chỉ cần cung cấp sơ đồ khái quát gồm (a) công nghệ chính (React/Vue/Angular, state-management, routing, UI library), (b) cấu trúc thư mục tổng quát (src/components, pages, services, utils, assets), (c) luồng gọi API và xử lý dữ liệu trả về, (d) cách triển khai responsive và build production. Kết quả cuối cùng là báo cáo rõ ràng, có mục lục, diagram (sequence, ER, component) và checklist đảm bảo mã nguồn backend hoàn toàn được hiểu rõ, frontend được mô tả tóm tắt đúng mức độ yêu cầu.

2: Tài liệu gốc mô tả khá rõ các khối hệ thống bắt buộc như web app, backend API, OCR processing, analytics summary, AI insight service, database, object storage, queue worker và cache. Vì vậy stack dưới đây được tối ưu theo mục tiêu:
3: - dễ cho AI đọc và sinh code,
4: - triển khai local nhanh,
5: - scale tách riêng frontend/backend/worker,
6: - giữ chi phí OCR và AI linh hoạt theo từng môi trường.
7: 
8: ## Kết luận kiến trúc được chọn
9: - **Frontend**: Next.js 15 + TypeScript.
10: - **Backend API**: FastAPI + Pydantic + SQLModel.
11: - **Worker**: TaskIQ ưu tiên, Celery là fallback nếu cần hệ sinh thái lớn hơn.
12: - **Queue/Broker/Cache**: Redis 7.x.
13: - **Database**: PostgreSQL 16.x.
14: - **Storage**: MinIO local, S3-compatible ở production.
15: - **OCR**: adapter interface, ưu tiên PaddleOCR; EasyOCR là fallback; Google Vision là dự phòng cloud.
16: - **AI Insight**: ưu tiên gọi trực tiếp provider adapter để đơn giản; chỉ dùng LangChain khi thật sự cần multi-provider workflow phức tạp.
17: 
18: ---
19: 
20: ## Ngôn ngữ và Runtime
21: 
22: ### Backend
23: - **Python**: `3.12+`
24: - Lý do:
25:   - Type hints giúp AI sinh code và refactor tốt hơn.

18:     ReceiptStatusResponse,

20: )

22: from app.services.ocr_queue import enqueue_ocr_job
23: from app.services.receipt_validation import validate_upload_file
24: 
25: router = APIRouter(prefix="/receipts", tags=["receipts"])
26: 
27: 
28: def _ensure_receipt_owner(
29:     session: Session,
30:     receipt_id: int,
31:     user_id: int,
32: ) -> ReceiptUpload:
33:     receipt = session.get(ReceiptUpload, receipt_id)
34:     if receipt is None or receipt.user_id != user_id:
35:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Receipt not found")
36:     return receipt
37: 
38: 
39: @router.post("/upload", response_model=ReceiptUploadResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
40: async def upload_receipt(
41:     file: UploadFile = File(...),
42:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
43:     current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
44: ) -> ReceiptUploadResponse:
45:     if current_user.id is None:
46:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid user")
47: 
48:     file_content = await file.read()
49:     settings = get_settings()
50:     validate_upload_file(file, len(file_content), settings.ocr_max_file_size_mb)
51: 
52:     extension = Path(file.filename or "").suffix.lower()
53:     generated_name = f"{uuid4().hex}{extension}"
54:     storage_key = f"{current_user.id}/{generated_name}"
55: 
56:     storage = get_storage_service()
57:     stored_object = storage.upload_bytes(storage_key, file_content, file.content_type or "")
58: 
59:     # Set PROCESSING TRƯỚC khi enqueue để tránh race condition:
60:     # nếu set sau enqueue, worker có thể finish (READY) trước khi API kịp ghi
61:     # PROCESSING -> API sẽ ghi đè READY thành PROCESSING -> frontend mãi thấy
62:     # processing dù đã xong.
63:     receipt = ReceiptUpload(
64:         user_id=current_user.id,
65:         file_name=file.filename or generated_name,
66:         content_type=file.content_type or "application/octet-stream",
67:         file_size_bytes=stored_object.size_bytes,
68:         storage_key=stored_object.storage_key,
69:         status=ReceiptStatus.PROCESSING.value,
70:     )
71:     session.add(receipt)
72:     session.commit()
73:     session.refresh(receipt)
74: 
75:     if receipt.id is None:
76:         raise HTTPException(
77:             status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
78:             detail="Upload failed",
79:         )
80: 
81:     enqueued = await enqueue_ocr_job(receipt.id)
82:     if not enqueued:
83:         # Rollback: queue down -> trả về UPLOADED + error code để frontend
84:         # có thể retry hoặc fallback sang manual entry. Không chuyển FAILED
85:         # vì lỗi nằm ở queue, không phải OCR engine.
86:         receipt.status = ReceiptStatus.UPLOADED.value
87:         receipt.error_code = "queue_unavailable"
88:         receipt.error_message = "OCR queue is not available. You can retry later."
89:         session.add(receipt)
90:         session.commit()
91:         session.refresh(receipt)
92: 
93:     return ReceiptUploadResponse(receipt_id=receipt.id, status=receipt.status)
94: 
95: 
96: @router.get("/{receipt_id}", response_model=ReceiptStatusResponse)
97: def get_receipt_status(
98:     receipt_id: int,
99:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
100:     current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
101: ) -> ReceiptStatusResponse:
102:     if current_user.id is None:
103:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid user")
104: 
105:     receipt = _ensure_receipt_owner(session, receipt_id, current_user.id)
106:     return ReceiptStatusResponse(
107:         receipt_id=receipt.id or receipt_id,
108:         file_name=receipt.file_name,
109:         content_type=receipt.content_type,
110:         status=receipt.status,
111:         error_code=receipt.error_code,
112:         error_message=receipt.error_message,
113:         created_at=receipt.created_at,
114:     )
115: 
116: 
117: @router.get("/{receipt_id}/ocr-result", response_model=OcrResultResponse)
118: def get_receipt_ocr_result(
119:     receipt_id: int,
120:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
121:     current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
122: ) -> OcrResultResponse:
123:     if current_user.id is None:
124:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid user")
125: 
126:     _ensure_receipt_owner(session, receipt_id, current_user.id)
127:     ocr_result = session.exec(
128:         select(OcrResult).where(OcrResult.receipt_upload_id == receipt_id),
129:     ).first()
130:     if ocr_result is None:
131:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="OCR result not ready")
132: 
133:     return OcrResultResponse(
134:         receipt_id=receipt_id,
135:         provider=ocr_result.provider,
136:         status=ocr_result.status,
137:         raw_text=ocr_result.raw_text,
138:         confidence=ocr_result.confidence,
139:         normalized_payload=ocr_result.normalized_payload,
140:     )
141: 
142: 
143: @router.get("/{receipt_id}/draft", response_model=DraftReviewResponse)
144: def get_receipt_draft(
145:     receipt_id: int,
146:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
147:     current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
148: ) -> DraftReviewResponse:
149:     """Trả về payload review draft cho frontend (Phase 3.2).
150: 
151:     Frontend dùng response này render review form đã pre-fill amount/merchant/
152:     date/currency từ OCR + suggested category từ user merchant mapping.

1: """Service `ocr_queue` — producer phía API push OCR job vào TaskIQ Redis queue.
2: 
3: Thiết kế:
4: - Reuse cùng broker config (Redis URL) với worker thông qua `pfa_shared.config`.
5: - Đăng ký một "proxy task" cùng tên với task của worker (`tasks:process_ocr_job`)
6:   để API có thể dispatch qua kicker tiêu chuẩn của TaskIQ. Body của proxy task
7:   chỉ raise vì execution thực do worker đảm nhiệm.
8: - KHÔNG còn `sys.path.insert` (anti-pattern import worker code từ API).
9: - Lỗi enqueue được log đầy đủ thay vì swallow im lặng.
10: - M5: broker được startup/shutdown qua FastAPI lifespan thay vì lazy connect
11:   ở lần enqueue đầu (xem `app/main.py`).
12: """
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: from functools import lru_cache
16: 
17: from pfa_shared.config import CommonSettings
18: from taskiq import AsyncBroker
19: from taskiq_redis import ListQueueBroker, RedisAsyncResultBackend
20: 
21: from app.core.logging import get_logger
22: 
23: logger = get_logger("api.ocr_queue")
24: 
25: # Tên task phải khớp với task worker decorate trong `backend/worker/tasks.py`.
26: # TaskIQ default task_name = f"{module_name}:{func_name}".
27: OCR_TASK_NAME = "tasks:process_ocr_job"
28: 
29: 
30: @lru_cache(maxsize=1)
31: def get_ocr_broker() -> AsyncBroker:
32:     """Build broker singleton dùng cùng Redis với worker.
33: 
34:     Đăng ký proxy task với cùng `task_name` như worker để API có thể dispatch
35:     qua kicker tiêu chuẩn. Body chỉ raise vì execution thực do worker xử lý.
36:     """
37:     settings = CommonSettings.from_env()
38:     broker = ListQueueBroker(url=settings.redis_url).with_result_backend(
39:         RedisAsyncResultBackend(redis_url=settings.redis_url),
40:     )
41: 
42:     @broker.task(task_name=OCR_TASK_NAME)
43:     async def _process_ocr_job_proxy(receipt_id: int) -> str:  # noqa: ARG001
44:         raise NotImplementedError(
45:             "process_ocr_job is consumed by the worker process, not the API",
46:         )
47: 
48:     return broker
49: 
50: 
51: async def startup_ocr_broker() -> bool:
52:     """Khởi tạo broker khi API startup (gọi từ FastAPI lifespan).
53: 
54:     Returns:
55:         True nếu startup thành công, False nếu broker không init được
56:         (vd. Redis down). API vẫn chạy được — `enqueue_ocr_job` sẽ trả
57:         False và endpoint upload sẽ rollback sang trạng thái UPLOADED
58:         kèm `error_code=queue_unavailable`.
59:     """
60:     try:
61:         broker = get_ocr_broker()
62:         await broker.startup()
63:     except Exception:
64:         logger.exception("ocr_queue.startup_failed")
65:         return False
66:     logger.info("ocr_queue.startup_ok task=%s", OCR_TASK_NAME)
67:     return True
68: 
69: 
70: async def shutdown_ocr_broker() -> None:
71:     """Đóng broker khi API shutdown (gọi từ FastAPI lifespan)."""
72:     try:
73:         broker = get_ocr_broker()
74:         await broker.shutdown()
75:     except Exception:
76:         logger.exception("ocr_queue.shutdown_failed")
77:     else:
78:         logger.info("ocr_queue.shutdown_ok")
79: 
80: 
81: async def enqueue_ocr_job(receipt_id: int) -> bool:
82:     """Đẩy OCR job vào queue Redis cho worker xử lý.
83: 
84:     Returns:
85:         True khi enqueue thành công.
86:         False khi fail (đã log lỗi đầy đủ kèm `receipt_id` để truy vết).
87:     """
88:     broker = get_ocr_broker()
89:     task = broker.find_task(OCR_TASK_NAME)
90:     if task is None:
91:         logger.error(
92:             "ocr_queue.task_not_registered name=%s receipt_id=%s",
93:             OCR_TASK_NAME,
94:             receipt_id,
95:         )
96:         return False
97: 
98:     try:
99:         await task.kiq(receipt_id)
100:     except Exception:
101:         logger.exception(
102:             "ocr_queue.enqueue_failed receipt_id=%s task=%s",
103:             receipt_id,
104:             OCR_TASK_NAME,
105:         )
106:         return False
107: 
108:     logger.info(
109:         "ocr_queue.enqueue_success receipt_id=%s task=%s",
110:         receipt_id,
111:         OCR_TASK_NAME,
112:     )
113:     return True

1: """TaskIQ worker tasks.
2: 
3: M5 refactor:
4: - Bỏ raw SQL, dùng SQLModel ORM (cùng `pfa_shared.entities` với API).
5: - Bỏ hardcoded `Path("data/receipts")`, dùng `pfa_shared.storage` adapter
6:   (local hoặc S3 tùy `STORAGE_BACKEND` env var).
7: - Tách core logic `run_ocr_for_receipt(session, storage, provider, receipt_id)`
8:   để test có thể unit-test với SQLite + LocalStorage.
9: """
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: import json
13: from datetime import UTC, datetime
14: 
15: from pfa_shared.entities import OcrResult, ReceiptUpload
16: from pfa_shared.enums import ReceiptStatus
17: from pfa_shared.storage import (
18:     StorageNotFoundError,
19:     StorageService,
20:     build_storage_service,
21: )
22: from sqlmodel import Session, create_engine, select
23: 
24: from ocr_provider import OCRProvider, get_ocr_provider
25: from worker_app import broker, settings
26: 
27: 
28: def build_ping_response() -> str:
29:     return "ping"
30: 
31: 
32: @broker.task
33: async def ping_task() -> str:
34:     return build_ping_response()
35: 
36: 
37: def run_ocr_for_receipt(
38:     session: Session,
39:     storage: StorageService,
40:     provider: OCRProvider,
41:     receipt_id: int,
42: ) -> str:
43:     """Core logic của OCR job — testable không cần Redis/TaskIQ.
44: 
45:     Returns one of: "missing_receipt", "ready", "failed".
46:     """
47:     receipt = session.get(ReceiptUpload, receipt_id)
48:     if receipt is None:
49:         return "missing_receipt"
50: 
51:     # Bước 1: đánh dấu PROCESSING (idempotent — chạy lại task không sao).
52:     receipt.status = ReceiptStatus.PROCESSING.value
53:     receipt.error_code = None
54:     receipt.error_message = None
55:     session.add(receipt)
56:     session.commit()
57: 
58:     try:
59:         # Bước 2: tải bytes từ storage (local FS hoặc S3).
60:         try:
61:             content = storage.download_bytes(receipt.storage_key)
62:         except StorageNotFoundError as exc:
63:             raise RuntimeError(f"storage_key missing: {receipt.storage_key}") from exc
64: 
65:         # Bước 3: gọi OCR provider.
66:         raw_result = provider.extract_text(content, source_hint=receipt.storage_key)
67:         normalized = provider.normalize_receipt(raw_result)
68: 
69:         payload = {
70:             "merchant": normalized.merchant,
71:             "transaction_date": normalized.transaction_date,
72:             "total_amount": str(normalized.total_amount),
73:             "currency": normalized.currency,
74:         }
75: 
76:         # Bước 4: upsert OcrResult.
77:         existing = session.exec(
78:             select(OcrResult).where(OcrResult.receipt_upload_id == receipt_id),
79:         ).first()
80:         now = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
81: 
82:         if existing is None:
83:             session.add(
84:                 OcrResult(
85:                     receipt_upload_id=receipt_id,
86:                     provider=raw_result.provider,
87:                     raw_text=raw_result.raw_text,
88:                     confidence=raw_result.confidence,
89:                     normalized_payload=json.dumps(payload),
90:                     status=ReceiptStatus.READY.value,
91:                     created_at=now,
92:                 ),
93:             )
94:         else:
95:             existing.provider = raw_result.provider
96:             existing.raw_text = raw_result.raw_text
97:             existing.confidence = raw_result.confidence
98:             existing.normalized_payload = json.dumps(payload)
99:             existing.status = ReceiptStatus.READY.value
100:             session.add(existing)
101: 
102:         # Bước 5: đánh dấu receipt READY.
103:         receipt.status = ReceiptStatus.READY.value
104:         receipt.error_code = None
105:         receipt.error_message = None
106:         session.add(receipt)
107:         session.commit()
108:         return "ready"
109: 
110:     except Exception as exc:
111:         # Rollback bất kỳ pending change → ghi lại receipt với status FAILED.
112:         session.rollback()
113:         receipt = session.get(ReceiptUpload, receipt_id)
114:         if receipt is not None:
115:             receipt.status = ReceiptStatus.FAILED.value
116:             receipt.error_code = "ocr_failed"
117:             receipt.error_message = str(exc)[:500]
118:             session.add(receipt)
119:             session.commit()
120:         return "failed"
121: 
122: 
123: @broker.task
124: async def process_ocr_job(receipt_id: int) -> str:
125:     """TaskIQ entry point. Tạo engine + session + storage cho mỗi job (worker
126:     là long-lived; engine pooled qua sqlmodel). Body delegate sang
127:     `run_ocr_for_receipt` để dễ unit test."""
128:     engine = create_engine(settings.database_url)
129:     storage = build_storage_service(settings)
130:     provider = get_ocr_provider()
131: 
132:     with Session(engine) as session:
133:         return run_ocr_for_receipt(session, storage, provider, receipt_id)

1: """Dashboard summary API (Phase 4.3).
2: 
3: Endpoint:
4: - `GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary?range=7d`
5:   - Query params:
6:     - `range`: preset key — "7d" | "30d" | "this_month" | "last_month" | "custom"
7:     - `start_date`, `end_date`: yêu cầu khi `range=custom` (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD)
8:     - `top_categories_limit`, `recent_transactions_limit`: optional, capped.
9:   - Trả `DashboardSummaryResponse` (current period + previous period + top
10:     categories + recent transactions). Frontend không tính business logic.
11: """
12: from __future__ import annotations
13: 
14: from datetime import date
15: 
16: from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
17: from sqlmodel import Session

20: from app.dependencies.auth import get_current_user

23:     CategoryBreakdownResponse,
24:     DashboardSummaryResponse,
25:     PeriodTotalsResponse,
26:     RangeInfo,
27:     RecentTransactionResponse,
28: )
29: from app.services.analytics import (
30:     DEFAULT_RECENT_TRANSACTIONS_LIMIT,
31:     DEFAULT_TOP_CATEGORIES_LIMIT,
32:     compute_summary,
33: )
34: from app.services.date_ranges import (
35:     DateRange,
36:     InvalidDateRangeError,
37:     RangePreset,
38:     previous_period,
39:     resolve_range,
40: )
41: 
42: router = APIRouter(prefix="/dashboard", tags=["dashboard"])
43: 
44: # Cap limits để tránh client request quá nhiều rows một lúc.
45: MAX_TOP_CATEGORIES_LIMIT = 20
46: MAX_RECENT_TRANSACTIONS_LIMIT = 50
47: 
48: 
49: def _build_range_info(range_: DateRange, preset: RangePreset) -> RangeInfo:
50:     return RangeInfo(
51:         preset=preset.value,
52:         start=range_.start,
53:         end=range_.end,
54:         days=range_.days,
55:     )
56: 
57: 
58: @router.get(
59:     "/summary",
60:     response_model=DashboardSummaryResponse,
61:     name="dashboard_summary",
62: )
63: def get_dashboard_summary(
64:     range: str = Query(  # noqa: A002 - matching API contract
65:         "30d",
66:         description="Preset range: 7d | 30d | this_month | last_month | custom",
67:     ),
68:     start_date: date | None = Query(
69:         None,
70:         description="Required when range=custom (ISO date)",
71:     ),
72:     end_date: date | None = Query(
73:         None,
74:         description="Required when range=custom (ISO date)",
75:     ),
76:     top_categories_limit: int = Query(
77:         DEFAULT_TOP_CATEGORIES_LIMIT,
78:         ge=1,
79:         le=MAX_TOP_CATEGORIES_LIMIT,
80:         description="Số top categories trả về",
81:     ),
82:     recent_transactions_limit: int = Query(
83:         DEFAULT_RECENT_TRANSACTIONS_LIMIT,
84:         ge=1,
85:         le=MAX_RECENT_TRANSACTIONS_LIMIT,
86:         description="Số recent transactions trả về",
87:     ),
88:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
89:     current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
90: ) -> DashboardSummaryResponse:
91:     """Tính toán dashboard summary cho user hiện tại.
92: 
93:     Status code:
94:     - 200: trả payload bình thường (kể cả khi không có giao dịch — empty arrays).
95:     - 400: range preset không hợp lệ hoặc custom range thiếu start_date/end_date.
96:     - 401: chưa đăng nhập (xử lý ở `get_current_user`).
97:     """
98:     if current_user.id is None:
99:         raise HTTPException(
100:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
101:             detail="Invalid user",
102:         )
103: 
104:     # Parse preset string → enum (raise 400 nếu invalid).
105:     try:
106:         preset = RangePreset(range)
107:     except ValueError as exc:
108:         raise HTTPException(
109:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
110:             detail=(
111:                 f"Invalid range preset: {range!r}. "
112:                 f"Allowed: {[p.value for p in RangePreset]}"
113:             ),
114:         ) from exc
115: 
116:     # Resolve current + previous range (raise 400 nếu custom invalid).
117:     try:
118:         current_range = resolve_range(
119:             preset,
120:             custom_start=start_date,
121:             custom_end=end_date,
122:         )
123:     except InvalidDateRangeError as exc:
124:         raise HTTPException(
125:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
126:             detail=str(exc),
127:         ) from exc
128: 
129:     previous_range = previous_period(current_range, preset)
130: 
131:     summary = compute_summary(
132:         session,
133:         current_user.id,
134:         current_range,
135:         previous_range,
136:         top_categories_limit=top_categories_limit,
137:         recent_transactions_limit=recent_transactions_limit,
138:     )
139: 
140:     return DashboardSummaryResponse(

142:         previous_range=_build_range_info(previous_range, preset),

144:             total_spend=summary.current.total_spend,
145:             transaction_count=summary.current.transaction_count,
146:         ),
147:         previous=PeriodTotalsResponse(

149:             transaction_count=summary.previous.transaction_count,
150:         ),
151:         delta_amount=summary.delta_amount,
152:         delta_percent=summary.delta_percent,
153:         top_categories=[
154:             CategoryBreakdownResponse(
155:                 category_id=cat.category_id,
156:                 name=cat.name,
157:                 color=cat.color,
158:                 total_amount=cat.total_amount,
159:                 transaction_count=cat.transaction_count,
160:                 percentage=cat.percentage,
161:             )
162:             for cat in summary.top_categories
163:         ],
164:         recent_transactions=[
165:             RecentTransactionResponse(
166:                 id=tx.id,
167:                 merchant_name=tx.merchant_name,
168:                 amount=tx.amount,
169:                 currency=tx.currency,
170:                 transaction_date=date.fromisoformat(tx.transaction_date),
171:                 category_id=tx.category_id,
172:                 category_name=tx.category_name,
173:             )
